text:
maria (PM): Quick sync  we need a lean GA plan for Private Deploy. Customers demand preserved egress identity + safe upgrades.

alex (Eng): Proposal: 3 lanes - Minimal installer GA (fast), Upgrade-aware operator Beta (canary + KV transfer), Full VPC handoff (IP-preserve modes).

jordan (Netops): Tech choices: sticky SNAT in-customer, lightweight SNAT appliance, or hosted relay. Appliance = private but customer ops; relay = easier but legal/privacy review.

lisa (Field): Field: ACME, Nimbus want IP preserved or they delay. They only open firewall windows quarterly.

elena (Legal): Hosted relay needs privacy assessment; mark as blocked until completed.

sam (SRE): Define zero-downtime: <1% 5xxs, KV miss <0.5%, rollback <10m. Canary automation must enforce thresholds.

maria (PM): Actions: Alex spike operator shim POC (10d), Jordan risk matrix (5d), Elena start privacy review (3w), Sam canary playbook (2w), Lisa collect beta customers (5d). GA target: Minimal installer in 2 sprints; shim Beta after POC.

alex (Eng): Will add an IP_PRESERVE_MODE feature flag for Beta only. Demo script will include kubectl patch + kv-transfer job.

lisa (Field): Request: include rollback checklist + SE oncall for upgrade windows; field needs <2h support SLA to sell upgrades.

maria (PM): Agreed. I'll produce RFC w/ lanes, ACs, timeline by EOD. Flag blockers here. :rocket:
